image_description: A highly ornate, Gothic-style stone altar situated within a cathedral or church sanctuary. The altar features a central white marble table draped with a fringed cloth, flanked by twisted Solomonic columns and elaborate stone carvings. Behind the altar is a golden reredos (altarpiece) containing statues of religious figures, framed by an archway. Red flowers in vases are placed on either side of the central statue.
